name: Estimate basis pack
summary: An estimator pricing a job from drawings, takeoffs and supplier quotes gets one worksheet: every figure with its quantity source, rate source and date beside it, each exclusion listed and every gap already written as a scope question. The estimator verifies; the bid lead decides the figure.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of construction estimating work, and its rules for prepared work: every figure carries its basis, every gap is a question for a named role, and a person verifies and decides.
